turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who gave Owen a zero before anyone spoke to me?
That isn't evidence, Hale. What do you actually have?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
I'm not here to be complimented. Show me something with a date on it.
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
Not while my son has a zero. Who decided?
